# GupShupGo

> GupShupGo is the private chat app for Android that works even without internet. It combines default Signal-protocol end-to-end encryption with offline nearby Bluetooth mesh messaging, chat streaks (Bonds), anonymous stranger chat, in-chat games (Gup Arcade), a secret PIN-protected Vault, and an integrated Gup AI assistant.

## About

GupShupGo lets you communicate privately with friends and family through end-to-end encrypted messaging powered by the Signal protocol. The app is available on Android and offers a comprehensive suite of communication features: real-time private messaging, HD voice and video calls with live screen sharing, offline nearby chat with zero internet or SIM, anonymous stranger chat with blurred media, Gup Arcade mini-games with points and badges, chat streaks with a 24-hour restore window, Moments (24-hour disappearing stories), an integrated Gup AI assistant, and a PIN-protected Secret Vault.

## Key Features

- **Offline Nearby Chat (Zero Internet)**: Message nearby friends over Bluetooth and local Wi-Fi when cellular networks drop, in flights, concerts, or remote trips. No internet, data, or SIM needed.
- **PIN-Protected Secret Vault**: Keep confidential chats hidden and locked behind a dedicated secret PIN on your device, shielded with automatic screenshot blocking.
- **Automatic Privacy (Default E2EE)**: Every chat, call, media file, and status update is end-to-end encrypted by default using the trusted Signal protocol.
- **Chat Streaks & Friend Bonds**: Build daily messaging streaks with friends with a forgiving 24-hour restore window so your streak is never lost by accident.
- **In-Chat Games & Arcade**: Play casual mini-games with friends inside chats, complete challenges, earn points, and unlock profile badges.
- **Anonymous Stranger Chat**: Meet new people 1-on-1 with random nicknames, tap-to-reveal blurred photos, and zero phone number exposure.
- **Moments (24h Ephemeral Stories)**: Share rich photo, video, and text stories that disappear after 24 hours, with direct encrypted in-chat replies and privacy controls.
- **HD Calls & Live Screen Sharing**: Crystal-clear voice and video calls with real-time screen sharing and full-screen incoming call alerts when locked.
- **Built-in Gup AI Assistant**: Helpful built-in AI assistant directly inside the app for quick answers, creative ideas, and daily assistance.
- **Instant 1-Tap Sign-In**: Instant SIM phone number verification so you can log in immediately without waiting for delayed SMS codes.
- **QR Contact Adding**: Quickly add friends and start conversations by scanning on-screen QR codes without typing numbers.
- **100% Open Source**: Transparent, open-source Android app code under the MIT license with zero ad tracking or data selling.

## Key Differentiators: GupShupGo vs WhatsApp & Telegram

These are the standout capabilities built into GupShupGo that WhatsApp and Telegram do not offer:

| Key Differentiator | GupShupGo | WhatsApp | Telegram |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Works with No Internet** | **Yes** (Offline nearby Bluetooth & Wi-Fi mesh) | No (Strictly requires active internet) | No (Strictly requires active internet) |
| **Chat Streaks & Friend Bonds** | **Yes** (Daily streak counters + 24h restore window) | No (Not available) | No (Not available) |
| **PIN-Protected Secret Vault** | **Yes** (Dedicated secret PIN + screenshot blocking) | No (Basic phone screen lock only) | No (Basic app passcode only) |
| **In-Chat Games & Arcade** | **Yes** (Native Gup Arcade with points & badges) | No (Not available) | No (External web bots only) |
| **Anonymous Stranger Chat** | **Yes** (1-on-1 random chats, blurred photos, 0 phone leak) | No (Phone numbers exposed to everyone) | No (Phone required, no stranger matching) |
| **Instant 1-Tap SIM Sign-In** | **Yes** (Instant carrier verification, zero SMS wait) | No (Standard SMS delay timer) | No (Standard SMS delay timer) |
| **Default Encryption on Everything** | **Yes** (Signal protocol on by default for all chats, calls & status) | Partial (Personal chats only; cloud backup leaks) | No (Default cloud chats stored plaintext on company servers) |
| **100% Open Source Transparency** | **Yes** (100% open source under MIT license) | No (Closed-source proprietary code) | Partial (Client apps open; server proprietary) |
